meta.title: Homie
meta.description: Run your shared home: shopping, tasks, events and what's happening today.

today.waitingOverdueOne: One of them is already late
today.houseCalm: A calm day starts with a tidy home

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.lead: What's waiting in the days ahead
calendar.prepareHint: Events in the next two weeks that need something done beforehand.

shopping.title: Shopping
shopping.lead: Everything the house needs, in one place
shopping.cartCalm: The cart is waiting for what home needs
shopping.emptyHint: Items you add show up here for both of you.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.lead: Let's put the house in order
tasks.emptyHint: Tasks you add will show up here.

auth.loginLead: Your email, then a code. No password.
auth.registerLead: A personal account for two parents. No password — just email.
auth.doorLead: Your home's tasks, shopping, and calendar in one place. Sign in with email, no password.
auth.newHere: First time here? The same code creates your account.
auth.spamHint: Can't find it? Check your spam folder too.
auth.linkExpired: That email link has expired. Ask for a new code.
auth.demoHint: Until Supabase is connected, the code is 123456.
auth.nameLead: This name shows up for the household, on tasks and shopping.
auth.setupLead: One household, two parents. Create it now, or join with an invite link.
auth.askInviteHint: Ask your partner for a link and open it from the message.
auth.inviteLead: Send this link to the other parent. It expires in seven days.
auth.newLinkHint: A new link cancels the previous one.
auth.linkReady: The link is ready to send
auth.joinLead: {inviter} is inviting you to the shared home.
auth.alreadyHomeHint: Leave your current household before joining a new one. This invite isn’t used up.
auth.alreadyHereHint: This invite is for the other parent. Send them the link.
auth.inviteExpired: This invite has expired. Ask for a new link.
auth.inviteUsed: This invite has already been used.
auth.inviteFull: This household is full. V1 has room for two parents.
auth.staleInvite: This invite is no longer valid. You can create a household instead.

errors.code: That code doesn't match, or it has expired.
errors.expired: The code expired. Send a new one.
errors.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait {seconds}s and try again.
errors.send: We couldn’t send the email. Try again.
errors.offline: You’re offline. This needs an internet connection.
errors.network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.mailLimit: Too many emails were sent in the last hour. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.mailNotAllowed: We can't email this address yet. Try a different one.
errors.name: Add a name the household will see.

settings.title: Our home
settings.homeNameHint: This is how the home appears to both of you.
settings.inviteHint: A one-time link for the other parent, valid for seven days.
settings.signOutHint: You can sign in later with a different email.

activity.title: What's new at home
activity.empty: Nothing here yet. When someone adds a task, something to buy, or an event, it shows up here.

push.title: iPhone notifications
push.body: Get a notification when something new happens at home.
push.denied: Homie's notifications are off in the iPhone's Settings.
push.failed: Couldn't turn on notifications. Try again.
push.on: Notifications are on. You'll hear when something new happens at home.
push.outdated: This iPhone has an older Homie. Update it in TestFlight to get notifications.

install.title: Homie on your Home Screen
install.body: Opens like an app: full screen, no address bar, and its own icon.
install.stepShare: Tap Share in Safari's toolbar. If you don't see it, tap ⋯ first.

connection.offline: You're offline. Your changes will be saved when the connection is back.

today.title: This is where the day starts
today.body: The greeting, the week, and the illustrated home show what's waiting. Pick a day to see its tasks and events.

tasks.title: Everything in one place
tasks.body: The household's tasks live here. Check one off when it's done, or add a new one with the plus button.

shopping.title: One list for both of you
shopping.body: Write what to buy, check off what's in the basket, and clear the bought items when you're home.

calendar.title: The household calendar
calendar.body: Pick a date to see that day, and add an event with anything you need to prepare.

settings.title: Your home
settings.body: See who's here, invite the other parent, and change the language and appearance.
